scope: eight California pilot identities near Imperial Valley and Coachella

records.evidence: California Highway Patrol lists El Centro Travel Center at 550 Wake Ave, I-8 at SR-86; state public-scale records use the same operator name and address. Overture names the site Super Stop Travel Center.
records.discrepancy: Mapped name differs from CSV; physical address and highway junction agree.

records.evidence: Trucker Path identifies Speedway 4346 at 1791 Maggio Rd, Calexico, on SR-7; NASTC lists the same branch on CA-7.
records.discrepancy: CSV gives SR-7 without street address.

records.evidence: Pilot operator lists ONE9 dealer 1271 at 2084 S Marina Dr, Thermal, and publishes matching site coordinates.
records.discrepancy: Several Overture POIs share this address under different names; choose the ONE9 feature, not an arbitrary co-located POI.

records.evidence: Pilot operator lists travel center 1132 at 234 Ben Hulse Hwy, Brawley, near CA-111 and CA-78.
records.discrepancy: Overture contains another Pilot Travel Center in Brawley at 1850 Main St; store number is needed to choose the correct site.

records.evidence: Love's operator page identifies store 749, OPIS 70452, at 551 West Main St, Westmorland, and its JSON-LD geo field publishes latitude 33.037837 and longitude -115.629103. The bounded Overture extract has no Love's feature there.
records.discrepancy: Name-only ranking proposed a different Love's location in Coachella; it must not be accepted.

records.evidence: Historical source describes The SoCo Group as a biofuel distributor in El Centro. Overture candidate at 350 E Main St is categorized as an industrial business, not a verified retail fueling site.
records.discrepancy: CSV says SR-111 and branch 4, but no evidence yet ties that branch to a drive-accessible public station.

records.evidence: Local report identifies a Chevron at 1496 Carrizo Gorge Rd near I-8, matching Overture's Jacumba Chevron. The neighboring Shell is a distinct site.
records.discrepancy: The source branch number 352416 is not independently tied to this particular Chevron.

records.evidence: Operator site identifies Shelee's Travel Center at 46355 Dillon Rd, Coachella, off I-10.
